business_summary: Dynamic Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of printed circuit board (PCB) products in China and internationally. It offers semi-flex PCB, heavy copper PCB, high-layer-count PCB, high-frequency PCB, and HDI PCB products for automotive electronics, networking and communications, and servers; display panel, storage devices; PC, consumer electronics, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Dynamic Electronics (Huangshi) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dynamic Electronics Co., Ltd. in February 2023. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Huangshi, China. Dynamic Electronics Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Dynamic Electronics Holding Pte Ltd.
